name: CM46_every_claim_carries_its_tier
origins: Card Model Research Handover, part 8 and its rules (2026-10-22)

provenance.source: Card Model Research Handover (2026-10-22), sections 8, 11 and the theorems the formal core needs

statement: Every claim carries the tier of its evidence: proof (checked by Lean's kernel, or a finite witness sized by a theorem for the claim's class, the class read from the code and never assumed), probabilistic proof (with its bound), bounded check (exhaustive within stated bounds), or sample.
